ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Timestomp
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may modify file time attributes to hide new or changes to existing files.
Timestomping is a technique that modifies the timestamps of a file (the modify, access, create, and change times), often to mimic files that are in the same folder.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.CreationTime\\ \\=.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.LastWriteTime\\ \\=.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.LastAccessTime\\ \\=.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[IO\\\.File\\]\\:\\:SetCreationTime.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[IO\\\.File\\]\\:\\:SetLastAccessTime.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[IO\\\.File\\]\\:\\:SetLastWriteTime.*"))
